headline: Effects of Joining CPTPP: Manufacturing Up 3.7 Times in 5 Years, Agricultural Damage Up 1.6 Times
summary: The South Korean government reanalyzed the economic effects of joining the CPTPP trade pact. It found manufacturing production ripple effects have grown 3.7 times and agricultural production declines have grown 1.6 times compared with 2021-2022 estimates.
why: The CPTPP is a trans-Pacific trade agreement covering a large group of economies. Its tariff and market access terms shape trade flows for exporters and farm sectors.
